basic_info.description: Three bedrooms and two bathrooms on two levels, remodeled with a tasteful blend of the traditional and the new. Large living room, separate dining room, kitchen with separate eating area and small deck, two bedrooms and a sunroom plus a downstairs guest room, bathroom and family room opening directly out to the patio/yard. Extensive seismic upgrades. One-car parking and storage in the garage. Quiet, charming, and less than a block from the waterfront.
